key.name: pins
key.description: The Sound applications sent to a sound device every time they play or record, in the popup's order. Each is a dictionary of "side" ("output" or "input"), "app" (the application's Flatpak app ID, name or binary), "device" (the sound server's name for the device), and what the popup shows while the application isn't running or the device is gone: "name", "icon" and "device-description".
